newsitem.title: INDIA: India grants mining leases to several companies.
newsitem.headline: India grants mining leases to several companies.

text.p: The Indian government on Friday announced awards of mining licences to several companies in its lastest bid to woo investment into the tightly held mining sector.

It said in a statement that the Mines Ministry had granted a mining lease to state-run Orissa Mining Corporation (OMC) to mine bauxite over 1,388.74 hectares in Rayagada and Kalahandi districts of the eastern state of Orissa.

It said OMC will transfer the lease to a 100-percent export-oriented, one-million-tonne-capacity alumina plant being set up by Uttkal Alumina International Ltd and jointly promoted by Indian Aluminium Co Ltd (INDAL), Tata Industry and Hydro Industries Ltd of Norway.

The ministry said it had also granted a two-year prospecting licence to Grasim Industries Ltd for limestone quarrying to set up a two-million-tonne-capacity cement plant on 462 hectares in Chittagong district of the northern state of Rajasthan.

The statement said the ministry had granted nearly 8,000 square km to BHP Minerals (India) Ltd, a unit of Australia's BHP, and about 1,915.52 square km to CRA Exploration India Ltd, to prospect for copper, lead, zinc, gold and silver.
It said CRA Exploration was supported by RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd, an international mining company now called Rio Tinto Plc/Ltd.
The ministry has also granted a lease to Indo-Nippon Special Steel Ltd to mine limestone in Nagaur district of Rajasthan.
The company would need to invest four billion rupees in the cement plant to achieve a one-million-tonne annual capacity within one year of execution of the lease.
In April, the ministry had approved a proposal by Larsen and Toubro to prospect limestone over 43 sq km in Rajasthan.
The company proposes to set up two cement plants with 1.5 million tonnes capacity each in two districts of the state.
In January the ministry had approved a prospecting licence for Metmin Finance and Holding Co Ltd in Sirohi district of Rajasthan to prospect for lead, zinc, gold and silver.
